record.question: Which of the following is not the feature of Aam?
record.explanation: Aam (Ama) features per classical Ayurveda texts (Ashtanga Hridaya, Charaka) include Gaurava (heaviness), Alasya (lethargy), Klama (fatigue/exhaustion), Srotorodha, Balabhransha, etc. Shrama means exertion or fatigue from work, not a symptom of Ama; Klama is the specific fatigue symptom of Ama.
